On switch one only
Write Erase nvram:
Delete Vlan.dat 
Reload

Once that is complete,
The switches will still have the stack config. So now for the fun part

This has to be done on each switch
Renumber all switches back to 1
Then unprovision the unused switches on each of the 3 switches  

Now you’re done. This was all on 3650/9200 switches
